kind: Per-event dispatch, rendering, camera and native-stage diagnosis of the pinned production Riemann GUI
source_map_check: All seven JavaScript bundles from a separate hidden-source-map build are byte-for-byte identical to the immutable deployed assets; their source maps were used without replacing production assets.
methodology: Two sequential controlled desktop runs, same native binary/assets/file, normal motion, no throttling or inference. Event dispatch durations are separated from the input/two-requestAnimationFrame proxy for that event type. The proxy is not physical presentation or field INP. Resize delivery is coalesced. Node selection includes one explicit Fit View followed by eight reachable-node clicks. Native stages overlap, thread CPU excludes child processes, zero CPU samples means unavailable; completed span IDs present at the initial snapshot are excluded. No span eviction occurred. Project and OS caches are warm; this is not cold installation or a statistical confidence interval. No application runtime optimization or deployment was made in this audit.

manifest.limits: Current-user native host and inherited workers only; no kernel stacks. Thread CPU spans exclude worker CPU. File preparation reuses project/OS caches, not a cold installation. Sampling changes timing; browser profiles have their own overhead.

findings.observation: Both complete-observation cache hits still run the actual Lake build/input resolution and fingerprint 43477 compiled inputs before displaying the cached result. This nested stage takes 19.979–23.847 seconds of the 24.897–29.040 second opens. Layout discovery takes 1.807–1.846 seconds; twelve configuration results are reused with zero new Lake configuration evaluations. Source-view materialization takes 0.409–0.412 milliseconds.

Sampled source positions include NativeWorkspaceGraph.tsx:468, project-map-model.ts:252/256 and WorkspaceMap. The legend predicate scans scene.areas on camera renders; the breadcrumb onMoveEnd also scans all areas. These paths bypass the existing branch-pruned visible-area query.

The sequence including explicit Fit View has a click p95 of 29.695–34.064 ms and a click/two-rAF p95 of 37.4–74.2 ms. One run records a 52 ms long task. Sampled DOM queries, Popper scroll-parent traversal and React work warrant a narrower selection/tooltip follow-up; these phase samples do not assign the entire delay to any one function.
